# #915 — CI: self-hosted check runner serves PostgreSQL 17, stack and db-integration are 18

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none

Updated: 2026-08-27T07:30:46Z

## What

The self-hosted `rodaddy` runner serves PostgreSQL 17 at 127.0.0.1:5432, and the `check` job (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:26-33`, note at `:139`) runs against whatever is reachable there. The stack is PostgreSQL 18 + pgvector (AGENTS.md); `db-integration` uses the digest-pinned `pgvector/pgvector:pg18` container (`ci.yml:189`), so the two CI jobs test different majors.

Surfaced by #910 (#904 step 1): once `scripts/local-clone.test.ts` actually ran on CI, its `postgresMajor: 18` assertion failed on the runner. #910 relaxes it to `>= 17` with a comment naming this mismatch; `scripts/local-clone.ts:307` keeps the exact-18 production assertion.

## Ask

Upgrade the runner's local server to PostgreSQL 18 (with pgvector), then restore the exact-18 assertion in `scripts/local-clone.test.ts`. Infra change on the runner host is Rico's; this issue records the need.

Filed by Claude (head, session 8) from the #910 fix lane's report.
